These numbers flag problems but do not rank registrations: judge alignment from the slices. NCC is computed within the atlas or the fixed image's nonzero voxels, and is only a rough guide between different contrasts. Jacobians are within the same region, and include any affine scaling. Each image has its own display window and gamma, so brightness is not comparable between images.
